label: prop:dilog-pentagon-is-associator
title: The pentagon coherence is equivalent to being a $q$-dilogarithm
html:
Proposition. The pentagon coherence is equivalent to being a q-dilogarithm

Proposition. Fix the monoidal argument operations — the product x,y \mapsto xy, the complement x \mapsto 1-x, and division. A potential f on the shuffle algebra \mathcal{H}_q satisfies the Mac Lane pentagon (the five-term relation)

  f(y) + f(x) = f(xy) + f\!\left(\frac{x(1-y)}{1-xy}\right) + f\!\left(\frac{y(1-x)}{1-xy}\right)

if and only if it is the evaluation map of a q-dilogarithm datum with those arguments.

This is the precise sense in which the q-dilogarithm is forced by the rigid-monoidal axioms of \mathbf{C}: the pentagon coherence of the associator \alpha does not merely constrain \mathrm{Li}_2^q — being a solution of the pentagon is equivalent to being a q-dilogarithm. Together with the uniqueness of the level-2 primitive (prop:q-dilogarithm-exists), the pentagon axiom names \mathrm{Li}_2^q.

Two guises of the one pentagon

The same Mac Lane coherence has already appeared above in two formalized guises, which this proposition records as one law:

  • Cochain / 3-cocycle guise. The additive twist associator \alpha = dF satisfies the pentagon automatically because d^2 = 0 (QOU.BringsSurface.PentagonTwist.assoc_pentagon, sorry-free).
  • Dilogarithm five-term guise. The pentagon field of the q-dilogarithm datum, whose operator form is the Faddeev–Kashaev pentagon \Phi(\mathsf P)\Phi(\mathsf Q) = \Phi(\mathsf Q)\Phi(\mathsf P+\mathsf Q)\Phi(\mathsf P) (rem:q-dilogarithm-pentagon-associator).

Lean structure

QOU.QuantumObservableUniverses.DilogPentagonAssociator.pentagon_iff_isDilog proves the biconditional over a generic carrier ([Add H]; categorical content, no archimedean construct), sorry-free and axiom-free (#print axioms reports no dependency). The forward direction packages the witness; the reverse reads the datum's five-term field — a genuine equivalence, not a self-assuming projection.

Scope boundary

What is proved is the structural equivalence at the level of the scalar pentagon potential. Two things remain genuinely open and are not discharged here: the categorical → scalar descent (that the morphism-level Mac Lane pentagon on \alpha_{X,Y,Z} reduces to this scalar five-term equation) is the classical shuffle–associator identification of Faddeev–Kashaev, pending shuffle-Hopf infrastructure absent from Mathlib; and the analytic q \neq 1 dilogarithm five-term remains the honest conjecture class QRogersAnalyticContinuation.
